# Pure Shield Restoration

> Owner-operated mold remediation and water damage restoration company based in Boca Raton, Florida, serving Palm Beach and Broward counties. Owners Ryan and Jon do the work themselves. Florida mold remediation license MRSR5407. IICRC certified. 24/7 response. Phone (954) 778-0925.

Pure Shield Restoration is a licensed mold remediator, not a mold assessor. Under Florida Statute 468.8419 the company that tests for mold cannot remediate the same job within 12 months, so Pure Shield refers testing and post-remediation verification to independent licensed assessors and presents that separation as a safeguard for the customer.

Services: mold remediation, water damage restoration, emergency water extraction, structural drying, help with insurance claims (not a public adjuster).

Service area: Boca Raton (home base), Delray Beach, Boynton Beach, Deerfield Beach, Pompano Beach, Coconut Creek, Coral Springs, Margate, Parkland. Residential homes, condos and HOA buildings, seasonal and snowbird homes.

## Services

- [Mold Remediation](https://pureshieldrestoration.com/services/mold-remediation/): containment, HEPA air scrubbing, removal of affected materials, verified-dry readings before rebuild.
- [Water Damage Restoration](https://pureshieldrestoration.com/services/water-damage-restoration/): extraction, moisture mapping, drying and documentation for insurance.
- [Emergency Water Extraction](https://pureshieldrestoration.com/services/emergency-water-extraction/): 24/7 standing-water removal.
- [Structural Drying](https://pureshieldrestoration.com/services/structural-drying/): dehumidifiers, air movers and daily meter readings until materials read dry.
- [Insurance Claims](https://pureshieldrestoration.com/services/insurance-claims/): what is usually covered, the mold sublimit, duty to mitigate, what not to do before the adjuster comes.
